about: Tolmachevo: Novosibirsk International Airport named after A. I. Pokryshkin, 17 km west of the city centre. Two runways, 3,597 and 3,602 m long. The terminal complex is designed for 1,800 passengers per hour on domestic routes and 1,300 on international routes.

transport.title: Getting there
transport.text: Express bus No. 111Э connects the airport with Novosibirsk-Glavny railway station every 30 minutes: from the station from 05:00 to 00:30, from the airport from 04:00 to 23:30. Suburban trains stop at Ob station near the airport; from there buses No. 4 (40 ₽), No. 111Э and No. 112 go to the terminal.

lounges.title: Lounges
lounges.text: Domestic business lounges Komfort and Premier on Level 2 of Sector C airside: after security on Level 3 opposite gate No. 6, go down following the signs. The international lounge is on Level 3 of Sector B, 50 seats. Paid visit 4,000 ₽ for 4 hours, children 2–12 years 2,000 ₽, under 2 free.

storage.title: Left luggage
storage.text: Left luggage for domestic and international passengers is in Sector C and is open round the clock. Baggage 500 ₽ per item per day, outerwear 100 ₽ per day. Storage of less than a day is charged as a full day.

kids.title: With children
kids.text: Mother and child room on Level 3 of Sector C, open round the clock and free. For departing passengers with children under 7, disabled children under 14 and women in the second half of pregnancy. There is a kitchen, a bedroom with cots and a playroom.

parking.title: Parking
parking.text: On the station forecourt the first 15 minutes are free, then the first hour 400 ₽, the second 300 ₽, then 200 ₽ per hour, over 6 hours 1,500 ₽ per day. Car parks P1–P4: up to 3 days 700 ₽ per day, up to 6 days 500 ₽, longer 300 ₽. Entry only with a recognised licence plate.
